exception: invalid literal for int() with base 10: '154a'
cause: Collection code parsed the whole prefix before underscore as an integer; existing migration names include 154a,175a,042b. This is a collector error, not a repository migration or product defect.
correction: Parse the leading numeric migration prefix using ^([0-9]+).
initial_partial_artifacts: API/git/active-change records had completed before the collector failed; facts.json was not produced until this correction.
